founder.description: My name is Kateryna — I am the founder of Fluyo School and an English teacher. I built a school where learning is meant to be comfortable, modern and genuinely useful for every student.

items.title: Education
items.body: A degree in English philology, qualified as a referent-translator of English. I work with students at levels A1–C1.

items.title: My path
items.body: I scored 184 in the ZNO English exam, went on to study translation, and in 2022, while travelling the world, I began teaching.

items.title: Communicative method
items.body: I chose the communicative approach at the very start of my teaching, and today it is the foundation of our lessons: less dry theory, more live English and practice.

items.title: Why Fluyo School
items.body: Fluyo School is about growth, support and confidence in yourself. It is a place where your potential opens up, and where teachers make the path to a result comfortable, vivid and meaningful.

enrollment.question: How do I sign up for lessons?
enrollment.answer: On our site you can press the «Book a consultation» button and message our manager about starting lessons. You can also reach us through Instagram Direct — the manager will help you pick a format and a teacher, and will answer every organisational question.

consultation-vs-trial.question: Which is better: a consultation or a trial lesson?
consultation-vs-trial.answer: At our school you can book a free consultation of up to 30 minutes. You will meet the teacher, get a feel for the atmosphere and how comfortable the conversation is, talk through your goals and organisational questions, and the teacher will get to know your level of English. A trial lesson is a full 60-minute class for 350 UAH: you join the learning process straight away, work with the materials and tasks, and see in practice whether the format and the teacher suit you. A consultation is for getting acquainted; a trial lesson is for trying the learning itself right away.

subscription-benefit.question: What is the advantage of learning on a package?
subscription-benefit.answer: We work with lesson packages, because regularity is one of the foundations of learning a language effectively. A package helps you lock in a steady schedule, study without long breaks, reach results faster and get a better price per lesson. Learning becomes more systematic, more regular and easier to plan around.

teacher-match.question: Can I choose my teacher?
teacher-match.answer: Of course. On our site and on Instagram you can read the teachers’ profiles in advance and pick the one who suits you best. Or you can leave it to us — we will match a teacher to your request, your goals and your expectations.

online-format.question: How do online lessons run?
online-format.answer: Before lessons start, our manager creates a shared group with the student and the teacher. A day before each lesson you get a reminder, so your schedule is easy to keep track of. Lessons run online in Zoom or Google Meet, with the interactive Miro board and the learning materials.

why-miro.question: Why Miro?
why-miro.answer: Miro is not only about interactive tasks — above all it is a convenient workspace for the student and the teacher. On the board the teacher builds the lesson around your goals and your request, combining coursebooks, presentations, exercises and extra materials. Everything is kept in one place, so it is easy to come back to during your studies.

progress-time.question: How long does it take to raise my level of English?
progress-time.answer: It is individual, and it depends on how regular your lessons are, on doing the homework, on systematic work and on your motivation. On our side we stay with you at every stage and do everything we can to keep your learning consistent and effective.

pair-lessons.question: Can I study together with a friend or a family member?
pair-lessons.answer: Absolutely. That is what our pair lessons are for — you can study together with a friend, a partner or a family member. This format makes learning more engaging, gives you more room for speaking practice, and at the same time keeps the cost per person lower.

format-choice.question: How do I know which format suits me?
format-choice.answer: It all depends on your goals, your pace and how you are most comfortable working. One-to-one lessons suit those who want a fully personalised programme, pair lessons those who want more interactive practice, and group lessons those for whom live communication and learning alongside others matter most. If you are not sure, we will help you choose a format that matches your level, your goals and your preferences.
